description: Ministry of Investment Promotion - Order under Section 53 of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No 11 of 2021 (IVIVA PTE LTD)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the specification of legal/regulatory matters under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021. It contains an order by the Minister that designates a business as a Secondary Business of Strategic Importance, specifies rationales, and outlines exemptions/incentives under specific regulations. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, it does not focus on his appointment or portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the regulatory implementation of the Act, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette.
